verdict.summary: Shopify makes you choose a distribution method up front, and you can't change it later. Custom distribution installs on one store, or on stores within one Plus organization, through an install link. Public distribution reaches any merchant but goes through App Store review, which Shopify staff put at 5-10 business days; developers report longer. Separately, reading customer data such as names, emails and addresses (through orders or customers) needs a protected customer data review. Composio has no managed Shopify app, so you need your own from day one.
verdict.hands_on_effort: 1-2 h to a dev-store install; days to prepare an App Store submission
verdict.approval_wait: custom: none; public: 5-10 business days stated, often longer reported; plus protected customer data review if needed

gates.name: Development store
gates.unlocks: Install and test on a development store. Protected customer data can be selected for testing without a review request.

gates.name: Custom distribution
gates.unlocks: Install on one merchant's store, or several stores in the same Plus organization, via an install link.
limits: Choosing custom distribution is permanent for that app.
Multi-store only within one Plus organization.

gates.name: Public distribution (App Store)
gates.unlocks: Any merchant can install; listing on the Shopify App Store.
limits: Protected customer data (Level 1/2) requires a separate review for public apps.

steps.title: Decide distribution before creating the app
steps.detail: If you serve a handful of merchants, custom distribution avoids App Store review entirely. If any merchant should be able to self-install, choose public. The choice cannot be changed later; you would have to create a new app.
gotchas: You can't change the method after you select it.

steps.title: Create a Shopify Partner account and a development store
steps.detail: Sign up for the free Partner program, then create a development store for testing.

steps.title: Create the app and declare scopes
steps.detail: Shopify recommends Shopify CLI. Scopes live in shopify.app.toml, which an agent can generate from your agent's actions. Composio's flow uses the authorization code grant (meant for apps that run outside the Shopify admin), so set the redirect URL to the Composio callback.

values.label: Redirect URL
values.value: Composio callback URL (see the Composio callout on this page)

gotchas: Composio's default Shopify scope list (36 scopes) includes read_customers and read_orders. Requesting customer fields triggers protected customer data review for public apps.

steps.title: Add the credentials to Composio and install on the dev store
steps.detail: Copy the client ID and secret into a Composio auth config for Shopify (OAuth2). Connecting needs the store subdomain (the authorize URL is per-store: {shop}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/authorize).

steps.title: Minimise protected customer data
steps.detail: Protected customer data is gated per field: an orders query that avoids customer fields doesn't need it. An agent can audit your queries and remove customer fields you don't need. Shopify approves only the minimum data required.

steps.title: Custom distribution: generate an install link
steps.detail: Generate an install link in the Distribution card and send it to the store owner. No App Store review is involved.

steps.title: Public: fix App Store review page issues and submit
steps.detail: Clear every issue flagged on the App Store review page, test on a development store, complete the listing, then submit. Request protected customer data access in the Partner Dashboard if you need it.

steps.title: Wait for review
steps.detail: Statuses move Draft → Submitted → Reviewed → Published. Shopify staff cite 5-10 business days; community reports range from about 10 business days to 5+ weeks in busy periods. Reply quickly when the app moves to Reviewed.

requirements.detail: Free; the Distribution card exists only for apps in a Partner organization.
For testing before any merchant install.
Level 1/Level 2 access requires review; minimum necessary data only.
All requirements on the App Store review page must be met before review.

scopes.effect: Protected customer data. Public apps need a Level 1/2 review; development stores can test without one.

blockers.symptom: Customer fields come back redacted or erroring in production
blockers.cause: Protected customer data access not approved for your public app.
blockers.fix: Request Level 1/2 access in the Partner Dashboard with a minimal-data justification, or stop querying customer fields.

blockers.symptom: Review has no reviewer assigned after weeks
blockers.fix: Make sure the app is not Paused for core requirements, then contact Partner Support. Consider custom distribution for early customers.

blockers.symptom: Need to switch from custom to public
blockers.fix: Create a new app with public distribution and migrate installs.

composio.note: Composio has no managed OAuth app for Shopify, so you need your own app even to prototype. Start with custom distribution for design partners while you decide whether to go public.

evidence.claim: Distribution is public (submit for review) or custom (install link; single store or one Plus organization); the method can't be changed after selection; the Distribution card only appears for Partner-organization apps.
evidence.quote: You can't change the method after you select it.

evidence.claim: App Store review statuses are Draft, Submitted, Reviewed, Published (or Paused); all App Store review page requirements must be met first.
evidence.quote: Your app must meet all requirements on the App Store review page before your app is reviewed.

evidence.claim: Public apps need review for Level 1 and Level 2 protected customer data; development-store apps can select data for testing; approval covers the minimum data required.
evidence.quote: To access customer data in development, select the data and fields you're using in the Partner Dashboard.

evidence.claim: Shopify staff say reviews usually take 5-10 business days but can be longer; developers report ~10 business days to 5+ weeks.
Shopify CLI is the recommended path; scopes are declared in shopify.app.toml; the authorization code grant is for apps that run outside the Shopify admin.
evidence.quote: declare the scopes your app needs in its shopify.app.toml configuration file

evidence.claim: The Shopify Partner program signup is public (partners.shopify.com redirects to shopify.com/partners).

Composio's Shopify toolkit has no managed auth; OAuth2 authorize URL is per-store https://{{subdomain}}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/authorize; 36 default scopes including read_customers and read_orders.
The per-store authorize endpoint only exists for a real shop: a probe against a non-existent store returns 404 'Store unavailable'.
Protected customer data is gated per field: orders queries without customer fields don't require it (Shopify staff reply).

open_questions: No official current App Store review SLA was found on shopify.dev; the 5-10 business day figure comes from a Shopify staff forum reply.
Protected customer data review turnaround is not published.
